summary: Travere Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $475M offering of 0.50% convertible senior notes due 2032, with an underwriters' over-allotment option of up to $50M. The notes mature May 15, 2032, bear 0.50% semi-annual interest, and are convertible into cash and/or common stock at an initial conversion price of ~$64.90 per share. Redemption is not permitted before May 21, 2029. This is a routine follow-on convertible debt offering, not a special situation like a restructuring or going-private transaction. The filing is a shelf takedown, not an event-driven catalyst.
